title: lemmaphyllum novoguineense
intro: Lemmaphyllum novoguineense, commonly known as the New Guinea shield fern, is a species of plant in the family Polypodiaceae. The New Guinea shield fern is a type of fern that is native to New Guinea, and it has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its medicinal properties. The plant is rich in health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce stress and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of the New Guinea shield fern include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which have been found to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, antihemorrhagic, and anti-inflammatory activities.
